description: JavaCV provides Java interfaces to computer vision and media libraries such as OpenCV, FFmpeg, libdc1394, FlyCapture, Spinnaker, and OpenKinect, built on top of the JavaCPP Presets wrappers for these libraries. It supplies utility classes for tasks like camera capture, video and audio recording/playback, and image and stereo processing, making these native libraries easier to use from Java and Android.
